summary: GEM-MULTISERVICE BYGG EWA JOLANTA GUTOWSKA (org. no. 914 316 154) is a sole proprietorship (ENK) based in Søndre Land, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2014-10-17. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 41.000 (Oppføring av bygninger); it has 0 registered employees. CEO: Mariusz Janusz Gutowski.
